About this lookup

    
This deployment checks two historical FDA records for one model. Validators fetch and verify the pinned scope snapshots. The notices list affected lot codes directly. They give no separate manufacturing-date criterion. An outside-scope decision only applies to the selected notices. Check the FDA records for current instructions and updates.
